System avatars
==============

Source: Fluent UI System Icons, Microsoft (MIT licence, see LICENSE).
Each picture is the icon's 24px regular SVG, copied unchanged from
assets/<Icon Name>/SVG/ic_fluent_<icon_name>_24_regular.svg in the upstream
repository. The fill is the upstream #212121, so every picture is a single
dark shape on a clear background.

The file name without its extension is the image code. The provisioning
handler attaches the two administrator pictures by their codes, and the
accounts-populate script names each service account's picture: a registry
service by its registry name with the dots replaced by underscores, and an
infrastructure account by the code stated beside it.

Code                      Icon
------------------------  ----------------
super_admin_avatar        Person Star
tenant_admin_avatar       Person Shield
ores_iam_service          Person Key
ores_refdata_service      Book Database
ores_workspace_service    Board
ores_dq_service           Shield Checkmark
ores_variability_service  Settings
ores_assets_service       Image Multiple
ores_scheduler_service    Calendar Clock
ores_reporting_service    Document Table
ores_telemetry_service    Pulse
ores_trading_service      Arrow Swap
ores_compute_service      Server
ores_synthetic_service    Beaker
ores_workflow_service     Flowchart
ores_ore_service          Calculator
ores_marketdata_service   Data Line
ores_analytics_service    Data Histogram
ores_http_server          Globe
ores_storage_service      Storage
ores_inbox_service        Mail Inbox
ores_compute_wrapper      Developer Board
ores_ddl                  Database Arrow Right
ores_shell                Code
ores_test_ddl             Database Checkmark
ores_test_dml             Table

To regenerate the SQL after a change here:

    python3 projects/ores.codegen/src/images_generate_sql.py --config system_avatars
